cover: What an AI agent harness is, and why it matters

slides.title: The model reasons, the harness acts
slides.body: The harness decides what the model sees, which tools it can call, when it stops and what counts as finished.

slides.title: Most agent failures aren't the model
slides.body: Wrong data, a tool error it couldn't read, no check on the result, or no rule for when to stop.

slides.title: Don't let it grade its own work
slides.body: Agents tend to rate their own output too highly. A separate check should decide what counts as done.

slides.title: Limits and approvals
slides.body: Step budgets, timeouts, and a person confirming anything expensive or irreversible before it happens.

slides.title: The harness is the part you keep
slides.body: Models change every few months. Your permissions, rules, checks and audit trail carry over.
